decisions.decision: Payment Plan and Schedule Line production DTOs use decimal-string Money and server-owned resourceVersion. Preview is read-only calculation; save, activate and cancel require If-Match. Client IDs, timestamps and calculated amounts are not accepted as command authority.

Payment Intent creation accepts business intent only. Backend assigns intent ID, checkout URL, expiry, lifecycle state, timestamps and version. Cancel and retry require authoritative If-Match; retry creates a new server-assigned intent.

Return credit/refund is a backend-owned asynchronous saga. The start command returns 202 with a persisted resolution projection. Frontend rollback, multi-repository coordination and fabricated refund completion evidence are forbidden in connected mode.

decisions.question: What retry/cancel transitions, provider idempotency retention and recovery guarantees apply to an existing Refund Intent?

decisions.decision: Customer-Credit-backed effective allocations are not automatically reversed or consumed by Return resolution. Saga persists MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED; finance must resolve through an explicit future command.
